## Description
 
Bug fixing.

## Fix

- Fixed main window title being reset when opening a pop-out window via "Open in new window" — the original window no longer reverts to the default title format
- Added layout-change event listener to catch title resets from hover previews (HoverEditor) and similar scenarios
Maintenance

## Minor Change

- Migrated settings from display() to getSettingDefinitions() for Obsidian 1.13.0+ (dual support — display() retained for backward compatibility)
- Replaced setTimeout with window.setTimeout for proper pop-out window timer compatibility
- Title updates now use a dedup check to avoid redundant DOM writes

## Full Changelog
https://github.com/zhao414/obsidian-reformat-windows-title/compare/1.0.4...1.0.5

releases.description:
## Changes
### Description
1. Added layout-change event listener to catch missed title resets caused by hover previews (HoverEditor) and similar scenarios
2. Added dedup check in updateTitle() / updatePopoutTitle() to avoid redundant DOM writes
3. Removed "on Windows" from package.json description — the code is fully cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux)
4.  `setTimeout` replaced with `window.setTimeout` for proper pop-out window compatibility

### Event coverage

- active-leaf-change  →  tab/file switching           (kept)
- layout-change       →  leaf add/remove, layout changes (new, covers hover, popover)
- window-open         →  pop-out window titles         (kept)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zhao414/obsidian-reformat-windows-title/compare/1.0.3...1.0.4

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
### Features

- Title order — Choose whether the file name or vault name appears first in the window title
- Custom separator — Set any text between the vault name and file name
- Show Obsidian version — Optionally append Obsidian x.x.x at the end of the title
- Use default — One-click reset to default settings

### Examples
|Setting	|Output|
|---|---|
|File name first, - 	|My Note - MyVault|
|Vault name first, \| 	|MyVault \| My Note|
|File name first, \| , +version	|My Note \| MyVault \| Obsidian 1.13.1|
|Use default	|My Note - MyVault - Obsidian 1.13.1|
### Fixes

- Fix Obsidian version not displaying (use apiVersion instead of DOM query)
- Remove unused settings heading per Obsidian plugin guidelines

### Compatibility

- Minimum Obsidian: 1.5.0
- Desktop only
